plainLanguage: Katy is a small city spread over three counties (Harris, Fort Bend and Waller). Unlike Houston, Katy has zoning, so your lot's district sets setbacks and size limits - our dataset does not yet have those numbers, so you will be asked to enter them from the city zoning map or your plat. We assume the 2021 residential code and climate zone 2A until verified. Katy is not in the coastal windstorm area. Many Katy-area homes are in HOA subdivisions whose rules (for example brick requirements) still apply even though state law limits city masonry rules. Plan for an engineer-designed slab because of the area's expansive clay.
